items.title: 〈滙豐經濟展望〉AI算力催生龐大電力缺口 看好能源、國防二大結構性主題
items.title_en: HSBC Economic Outlook: AI Computing Power Creates Massive Power Gap, Favoring Energy and Defense as Two Structural Themes
paras: 在全球 AI 技術加速普及的背景下，電力需求正迎來爆發性成長。滙豐銀行今(23)日發布2026年第四季投資展望，AI 與數據中心的擴建對電力提出了極高要求，預期未來幾年數據中心對電力的需求甚至可能超越電動車(EV)，使得「能源自主與國防安全」成為各國政府不可忽視的二大戰略核心。
滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監何偉華表示，數據中心龐大的耗電量，加上全球對碳排放與環保指標的嚴格要求，正大力推動再生能源(如太陽能、風能、核電)的投資。這類結構性需求不僅帶動銅等基礎金屬價格維持在高檔，也讓電網基礎建設相關企業直接受惠。
在安全與國防領域上，因地緣政治局勢持續緊張，北約成員國及亞洲部分國家(如南韓)正持續擴大國防支出，帶動航太與國防板塊盈利快速成長，是具備高度防禦與成長潛力的投資主題。
針對台灣今年經濟成長率的表現，何偉華表示，台灣前兩個季度經濟呈現雙位數高成長，下半年因去年同期基數較大，成長速度雖會較上半年放緩，但總體經濟動能依然強勁。
他強調，台灣與 AI 相關的出口具備不可替代性，全世界採購 AI 設備都必須依賴台灣供應鏈；內需方面，若政府發放現金振興方案發揮效益，將可加速民間消費回升。
亞洲整體市場來看，滙豐指出，亞太區目前占全球數據中心比重已超過一半，政策與電力支援相對到位，有利相關供應鏈發展。此外，亞洲企業的股東權益報酬率(ROE)普遍呈上升趨勢，建議投資人可採用「槓鈴策略」，一邊布局具高成長性的 AI 及半導體族群，另一邊搭配具備穩健股息的高股息股票，以兼顧資本利得與現金流收益。
paras_en: Against the backdrop of rapid global adoption of AI technology, electricity demand is set for explosive growth. HSBC released its Q4 2026 investment outlook today (23rd), noting that the expansion of AI and data centers places extremely high power requirements, and it expects data‑center electricity demand in the coming years could even surpass that of electric vehicles (EVs), making "energy independence and defense security" two strategic cores that governments cannot ignore.

HSBC Private Banking and Wealth Management North Asia Chief Investment Officer He Weihua said the huge power consumption of data centers, combined with strict global carbon‑emission and environmental standards, is driving strong investment in renewable energy such as solar, wind and nuclear. This structural demand not only keeps base‑metal prices like copper at elevated levels but also directly benefits companies involved in grid infrastructure.

In the security and defense arena, ongoing geopolitical tension is prompting NATO members and some Asian nations (e.g., South Korea) to continuously expand defense spending, boosting aerospace and defense sector earnings and creating an investment theme with high defensive and growth potential.

Regarding Taiwan’s economic growth this year, He noted that Taiwan posted double‑digit growth in the first two quarters; although the pace will slow in the second half because of a larger base year, overall economic momentum remains strong.

He emphasized that Taiwan’s AI‑related exports are irreplaceable—global AI equipment purchases rely on Taiwan’s supply chain. Domestically, if the government’s cash stimulus program works effectively, it will accelerate the rebound in private consumption.

Looking at the broader Asian market, HSBC pointed out that the Asia‑Pacific now accounts for more than half of global data‑center capacity, with policies and power support relatively in place, benefiting the related supply chain. Moreover, Asian firms’ return on equity (ROE) is generally rising, so investors are advised to adopt a "barbell strategy": allocate to high‑growth AI and semiconductor groups on one side and pair them with high‑dividend, stable‑yield stocks on the other to balance capital gains and cash‑flow returns.

items.title: 〈滙豐經濟展望〉估Fed 12月再升息1碼 AI助攻台灣企業獲利、經濟成長動能強
items.title_en: HSBC Economic Outlook Predicts Fed to Raise Rates Again in December, AI Boosts Taiwanese Corporate Profits and Economic Growth Momentum
paras: 滙豐銀行今(23)日舉行2026年第四季投資展望線上記者會，滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監何偉華指出，儘管過去數月半導體股價波動、美國利率變動及地緣政治等因素交織，但全球經濟與企業盈利仍優於市場預期。其中，台灣將繼續受惠於 AI 數據中心發展，雖下半年基期較高，未來的經濟與企業盈利成長前景依然樂觀，因此維持對全球股票的偏高配置，固定收益也具顯著機遇。滙豐預估美國聯準會 12 月將再升息 1 碼，2027 年則按兵不動。
滙豐私人銀行表示，全球主要經濟體的經濟驚喜指數多呈現正向，且製造業受惠於 AI 快速發展，對資料中心與半導體投資強勁，加上全球油價與大宗商品價格支撐，帶動整體製造業穩定成長。在通膨與利率方面，雖然美國通膨壓力仍存，使得美國聯準會於9月採取升息行動，但通膨數據仍在可控預期內，金融市場流動性對通膨產生的壓力相對穩定。
針對市場高度關注的美國利率政策，何偉華進一步指出，滙豐預估Fed在12月仍有再升息1碼(25個基點)的可能性，主要由於通膨回落至2%目標水平仍需時間，預計要到2028年，加上美國經濟增長強勁。
不過何偉華認為，升息對股市估值影響有限，且預測明年Fed將維持利率不動。在匯市方面，受鷹派政策、能源自給優勢及選後資金回流支撐，美元指數短線仍看升；日元在政府干預與利差因素抵銷下將呈區間震盪；離岸人民幣則受惠於中國強勁出口貿易順差與人民幣國際化政策推動，中長期將呈現溫和升值走勢。
在資產配置策略上，滙豐維持對全球股市「加碼」的立場。何偉華分析，全球約有 70% 的企業盈利預測獲得上調，市場盈利增長動力極強。針對市場關注的科技股估值問題，何偉華認為，經過第二季的股價修正後，美股科技股的估值已回落至合理水平，與非科技股差異不大，且科技業盈利增長顯著，因此「不需過度擔憂科技股存在泡沫」。
針對即將到來的11月美國期中選舉，滙豐研究過去 24 次期中選舉歷史數據顯示，雖然選前股市易受訊息面影響而波動，但在選後 12 個月內，有 22 次股市皆呈現上揚走勢。滙豐預期在不確定性消除後，市場將重新回歸基本面與合理估值，美股表現依舊看好。
就區域市場而言，滙豐看好美國、日本，以及包含台灣、南韓在內的北亞市場。針對債券與另類資產，滙豐指出，目前實質利率已處於具吸引力的偏高水平，建議投資人可持有所屬優質公司債至到期；同時搭配對沖基金、私募市場及黃金等資產，以提升多元投資組合的抗震韌性。
paras_en: HSBC held an online press conference today (the 23rd) for its Q4 2026 investment outlook. HSBC Private Banking and Wealth Management North Asia Chief Investment Officer He Wei-hua said that despite recent volatility in semiconductor stocks, US interest rate changes and geopolitical factors, the global economy and corporate earnings are still better than market expectations. Taiwan will continue to benefit from AI data centre development; although the base is higher in the second half, the outlook for economic and corporate profit growth remains optimistic, so HSBC maintains an overweight position in global equities and sees significant opportunities in fixed income. HSBC forecasts the US Federal Reserve will raise rates by one quarter-point in December and hold steady in 2027.

HSBC Private Banking noted that the economic surprise indices of major economies are largely positive, and manufacturing is benefiting from rapid AI development, driving strong investment in data centres and semiconductors. Supported by global oil and commodity prices, overall manufacturing is seeing stable growth. Regarding inflation and rates, US inflation pressure remains, prompting the Fed’s September rate hike, but inflation data stay within controllable expectations and market liquidity is relatively stable against inflation pressures.

Addressing the market’s focus on US rate policy, He Wei-hua added that HSBC expects a further 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December, mainly because it will take time for inflation to fall back to the 2% target—likely not until 2028—and because US economic growth remains strong.

He believes rate hikes have limited impact on equity valuations and forecasts the Fed will keep rates unchanged next year. In the currency market, the dollar index is expected to rise in the short term, supported by hawkish policy, energy self‑sufficiency and post‑election capital flows; the yen will trade in a range as government intervention and interest‑rate differentials offset each other; offshore RMB should modestly appreciate in the medium to long term, aided by China’s strong export surplus and RMB internationalisation policies.

On asset‑allocation strategy, HSBC maintains an “add‑to” stance on global equities. He notes that about 70% of corporate earnings forecasts have been upgraded, indicating very strong earnings growth momentum. Regarding tech‑stock valuations, he says that after the Q2 price correction, US tech valuations have fallen to reasonable levels, comparable to non‑tech stocks, and with strong earnings growth there is no need to worry excessively about a tech bubble.

Regarding the upcoming November US midterm elections, HSBC’s research of the past 24 midterms shows that although markets can be volatile before elections, in 22 of the 24 cases the market rose in the 12 months after the election. HSBC expects that once uncertainty clears, markets will revert to fundamentals and reasonable valuations, keeping a positive outlook on US equities.

Regionally, HSBC is bullish on the US, Japan and North‑Asia markets, including Taiwan and South Korea. For bonds and alternative assets, HSBC says real yields are now at an attractive high level, recommending investors hold quality corporate bonds to maturity and complement them with hedge funds, private‑equity and gold to enhance portfolio resilience.

items.title: 2027年全美大學排名出爐！ 指標迎歷史級重塑首納「就業回報」　普林斯頓15年神話破滅、MIT登頂
items.title_en: 2027 U.S. College Rankings Released! Metrics Undergo Historic Overhaul, Adding “Employment Return” for the First Time – Princeton’s 15‑Year Reign Ends, MIT Takes the Top Spot
paras: 《美國新聞與世界報導》公布2027全美最佳大學排名，麻省理工學院(MIT)首度登頂，打破普林斯頓自2012年版起連續15年霸榜格局。
根據最新排名，綜合大學前十名依序為MIT、普林斯頓、哈佛、耶魯，加州理工學院與史丹佛大學並列第五，賓大第七，杜克第八，約翰霍普金斯、西北、芝加哥並列第九。哥倫比亞、達特茅斯第十二，卡內基梅隆、康乃爾第十四。
《美國新聞與世界報導》表示，改版回應了學費高漲與投報率疑慮。對申請家庭而言，單看綜合名次已不夠，選校應同時核對目標專業薪資、畢業率、低收入生支持與地區產業連結，避免被短期洗牌誤導。
這項最新排名被教育界稱為近十年最顛覆，主因在指標重構。首先，排名首度納入「分專業畢業收入」，沿用美國教育部College Scorecard畢業4年各學門實際薪資，按領域同類對比，取代原有畢業負債指標，此舉對電腦、工程、量化金融就業轉化強的學校是利多，也是MIT登頂關鍵。
其次，「學生產出成果」權重逾50%，含畢業率、大一留校率、佩爾獎學金學生社會流動與起薪等硬指標。第三，卡內基分類調整，約20%學校重新分組，商科、工科、醫學專項校首度更完整納入綜合評比，歷史名次不宜直接縱比。第四，佩爾獎學金學生占比與畢業轉化權重上升，成為前25名拉鋸重點。
文理學院方面，威廉斯、阿默斯特續分列榜首與探花；公立學校以柏克萊、UCLA並列最佳，聖路易華盛頓大學、范德堡、萊斯等十六名群聚。
整體排名給出的信號是從「聲譽與資源」轉向「就業回報與社會流動」的排名。
paras_en: U.S. News & World Report released the 2027 Best Colleges ranking, with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) topping the list for the first time, ending Princeton’s 15‑year streak that began with the 2012 edition.

According to the latest ranking, the top ten schools overall are, in order: MIT, Princeton, Harvard, Yale, Caltech and Stanford tied for fifth, Penn in seventh, Duke in eighth, Johns Hopkins, Northwestern and Chicago tied for ninth. Columbia and Dartmouth are twelfth, Carnegie Mellon and Cornell are fourteenth.

U.S. News & World Report said the redesign responds to soaring tuition and concerns about return on investment. For applicant families, looking only at the overall rank is no longer enough; school selection should also verify target‑major salaries, graduation rates, low‑income student support and regional industry connections to avoid being misled by short‑term shuffles.

The new ranking has been called the most disruptive in a decade, mainly because of the metric overhaul. For the first time it includes “major‑specific graduate earnings,” using the Department of Education’s College Scorecard data on four‑year post‑graduation salaries by discipline, compared within fields, replacing the previous debt‑based metric. This benefits schools strong in computer science, engineering and quantitative finance and was a key factor in MIT’s ascent.

In addition, “student outcomes” now carry more than 50% weight, encompassing graduation rates, first‑year retention, Pell‑Grant student social mobility and starting salaries, among other hard indicators. A third change is the adjustment of Carnegie classifications, with about 20% of schools re‑grouped; business, engineering and medical specialty schools are now fully incorporated into the overall assessment, making historical rank comparisons inappropriate. A fourth change is the increased weight on the proportion of Pell‑Grant students and graduation conversion, making these metrics a focal point in the battle for the top 25 spots.

In the liberal‑arts segment, Williams and Amherst continue to occupy the top two spots, while public institutions Berkeley and UCLA tie as the best public schools. Washington University in St. Louis, Vanderbilt, Rice and other schools make up a cluster of sixteen institutions in the middle of the list.
The overall signal of the ranking is a shift from emphasizing “reputation and resources” to focusing on “employment return and social mobility.”

items.title: 花旗點名三大市場醞釀「空單回補」
items.title_en: Citi Flags Three Major Markets Ripe for Short Covering
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，花旗警告，全球股市投資人上週進一步降低風險部位，空頭部位在多個市場重新增加，尤以美國小型股、歐洲及部分亞洲市場最為明顯。目前部分空單已陷入虧損，一旦市場出現利多，日經指數、南韓 KOSPI 指數及標普 500 指數可能出現較大規模的空單回補行情。
由策略師 David Chew 領軍的花旗團隊指出，歐洲Stoxx 50指數及美國大型股的淨部位仍相對穩健，但投資人持續削減方向性風險，反映市場情緒轉弱。多個市場累積大量空頭部位，也使後續走勢呈現不對稱風險。
這波部位降溫發生在聯準會 (Fed) 3 年來首次升息、日本央行進一步調整政策、能源價格上漲及地緣政治緊張之際。花旗形容，這些因素共同引發本輪利率週期以來最同步的避險浪潮之一。
美國市場方面，三大主要股指均出現偏空資金流向，主要源自投資人新建空單，而非撤出多頭部位。其中，羅素 2000 指數的部位單週降幅居花旗追蹤的全球市場之首，目前所有剩餘多單都處於虧損。
相較之下，標普 500 指數及那斯達克指數展現較強韌性，持續出現的空單回補抵銷大部分偏空壓力。
花旗指出，標普 500 指數約 80% 的多單與空單目前均處於虧損，但由於空頭部位規模較大，市場風險明顯偏向空單回補。即使指數僅溫和反彈，也可能促使空頭平倉，帶來額外買盤。
歐洲方面，德國 DAX 指數及歐洲銀行股指數因新空單增加，部位轉為輕度偏空。歐洲斯托克指數雖出現區內最大規模的資金流出，整體部位仍保持偏多。
花旗認為，歐洲市場的主要風險正由方向判斷轉向部位壓力。多數指數的多頭部位已陷入虧損，其中 DAX 的損益結構在歐洲市場中最弱。
亞洲仍是全球部位最偏空的地區。日經指數的空頭傾向雖略有改善，但仍是主要市場中部位最偏空者；投資人也進一步增加南韓 KOSPI、香港恆生指數及中國 A50 指數的空單。
日經指數、KOSPI及恆生指數的空頭部位均接近歷史高檔，其中日經與KOSPI超過 40% 的空單已陷入虧損。花旗表示，任何正面催化劑都可能引發幅度不成比例的空單回補漲勢，日經指數面臨的風險尤其突出。
paras_en: Citi warned that global equity investors further reduced risk positions last week, short positions increased in several markets, especially U.S. small‑cap stocks, Europe and some Asian markets. Some shorts are now in loss; if the market receives positive news, the Nikkei, South Korea KOSPI and S&P 500 could see large short‑covering rallies.

Led by strategist David Chew, the Citi team said net positions in the European Stoxx 50 and U.S. large‑cap stocks remain relatively solid, but investors continue cutting directional risk, reflecting weaker market sentiment. Accumulated large short positions in many markets create asymmetric risk.

This cooling of positions occurs as the Fed implements its first rate hike in three years, the Bank of Japan further adjusts policy, energy prices rise and geopolitical tensions heighten. Citi describes these factors as sparking one of the most synchronized hedging waves of the current rate‑cycle.

In U.S. markets, all three major indices showed net short flows, mainly from investors opening new shorts rather than unwinding longs. The Russell 2000’s position fell the most in a single week among Citi‑tracked global markets, and all remaining long positions are now in loss.
By contrast, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq displayed greater resilience, with ongoing short covering offsetting most of the bearish pressure.

Citi notes that about 80% of both long and short positions in the S&P 500 are currently losing, but because short size is larger, market risk leans toward short covering. Even a modest rebound could trigger short liquidation and add buying pressure.

In Europe, Germany’s DAX and the European banking index turned lightly short as new shorts were added. The European Stoxx index saw the region’s biggest fund outflow, yet its overall position remains net long.

Citi believes the main risk in Europe is shifting from directional bets to position pressure. Most index long positions are in loss, with the DAX having the weakest profit‑loss structure among European markets.

Asia remains the most short‑biased region globally. The Nikkei’s short tilt has slightly improved but still is the most short‑biased among major markets; investors also added shorts on South Korea’s KOSPI, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng and China A50 indices.

Short positions in the Nikkei, KOSPI and Hang Seng are near historic highs, with over 40% of shorts on the Nikkei and KOSPI already in loss. Citi says any positive catalyst could spark a disproportionately large short‑covering rally, with the Nikkei’s risk especially pronounced.

items.title: AI助理Muse爆紅 會是Meta的「ChatGPT」時刻嗎？
items.title_en: AI Assistant Muse Goes Viral—Is This Meta's "ChatGPT" Moment?
paras: Meta(META-US)新推出的人工智慧(AI)助理Muse登上Apple美國App Store下載榜首，下載速度也超越ChatGPT早期表現，正在大幅提振市場對Meta AI策略的信心，也吸引華爾街投資人的目光。
與傳統聊天機器人不同，Muse旨在執行多步驟任務，例如預訂餐廳、撥打電話及寄送電子郵件。Muse的驚人熱度讓分析師更有信心認為，Meta將能運用深厚的社群媒體根基，在AI時代打造出爆紅應用程式。
摩根大通(JPMorgan)分析師Doug Anmuth周二(22日)說：「雖然還在早期階段，但我們認為，Muse有潛力成為自ChatGPT以來使用最廣泛的消費者AI應用程式。」
這對Meta而言是一次重要的突破，因為直到不久前，市場對Meta的AI策略和龐大的資本支出計畫，多半仍抱持懷疑態度。Muse推出後，Anmuth已經將Meta股票評級調升至「加碼」。
自9月初以來，Meta股價已上漲近30%，其中21%出現在Muse推出的短短兩周時間裡。
Anmuth指出，Muse具有多項優勢，包括介面容易上手、慷慨的免費方案，背後還有Meta在旗下各社群媒體平台上的龐大用戶群撐腰。
Anmuth進一步表示，Meta近期也加快AI產品推出速度，例如AI模型短短幾個月內能力就大幅躍升。Meta在7月推出Muse Spark 1.1，是Meta首次發布具備接近前沿水準程式設計能力的AI模型。
Meta開發者大會「Meta Connect」將於本周三(23日)起一連舉行兩天，Anmuth預期，Meta將進一步更新AI進展，以及Muse如何與合作夥伴和Meta硬體整合。

下一代模型Watermelon成投資人焦點

投資人目前最關注的，將是Meta下一款新模型「Watermelon」的發布日期，分析師認為可能在下個月稍晚推出。
Jefferies分析師Jeffrey Favuzza周二表示，「Meta Connect」開發者大會前市場升溫的熱情，可能帶來「利多出盡」行情，尤其Meta股價周一已大漲11%，但隨著下一款模型即將發布這項催化劑存在，「我們認為股價有更持久的底部支撐」。
Meta股價周二震盪走低，終場下跌0.6%。
美銀(BofA)分析師Justin Post認為，投資人先前一直擔心Meta打造差異化AI產品的能力。但Muse暢旺的人氣，還具備能完成填寫網頁表單等複雜任務的能力，已提升市場「對Meta AI投資報酬潛力的樂觀程度」。
Post進一步表示，Muse推出後的累計美國下載量，已超越其他AI應用程式同一時間點的表現。根據Sensor Tower數據，Muse在推出後12天內下載次數達143萬次，高於OpenAI ChatGPT同期的137萬次，以及Google Gemini的71萬次。
Post也提醒，Muse的人氣可能不會立即轉化為營收成長。他表示：「Muse的變現路徑，包括廣告、訂閱與佣金收入，在2028年以前似乎不太可能產生重大貢獻。」
不過，Post對Meta即將推出的Watermelon抱持樂觀態度，認為該模型可能帶來前沿水準的能力，並有望改善Meta核心廣告業務，同時增加模型託管收入。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) has seen its newly launched AI assistant Muse top the Apple US App Store download chart, with a download speed that even surpasses ChatGPT's early performance, significantly boosting market confidence in Meta's AI strategy and attracting Wall Street investors' attention.

Unlike traditional chatbots, Muse is designed to perform multi-step tasks such as booking restaurants, making phone calls, and sending emails. Its remarkable popularity gives analysts greater confidence that Meta can leverage its deep social‑media roots to create a breakout app in the AI era.
JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that although it is still early, he believes Muse has the potential to become the most widely used consumer AI application since ChatGPT.

This is a major breakthrough for Meta, as until recently the market remained skeptical about Meta's AI strategy and massive capital‑spending plans. After Muse's launch, Anmuth upgraded Meta's stock rating to "add".
Since early September, Meta's share price has risen nearly 30%, with 21% of that gain occurring in the two weeks following Muse's launch.
Anmuth pointed out several advantages of Muse, including an easy‑to‑use interface, a generous free tier, and the backing of Meta's massive user base across its social‑media platforms.

He added that Meta has been accelerating AI product rollouts, with AI model capabilities leaping forward within just a few months. In July, Meta released Muse Spark 1.1, its first AI model with near‑frontier programming abilities.

The Meta developer conference "Meta Connect" will run for two days starting Wednesday (the 23rd). Anmuth expects Meta to further update AI progress and show how Muse integrates with partners and Meta hardware.
The next‑generation model Watermelon is the focus for investors, who are keen to know its release date, which analysts think could be launched later next month.

Jefferies analyst Jeffrey Favuzza said on Tuesday that the market enthusiasm heating up before the "Meta Connect" developer conference could lead to a "buy‑the‑rumor" rally, especially since Meta's stock jumped 11% on Monday, but with the upcoming model as a catalyst, "we believe the price now has a more durable bottom support."
Meta's stock slipped on Tuesday, closing down 0.6%.

Bank of America analyst Justin Post noted that investors had previously worried about Meta's ability to build differentiated AI products. Muse's strong popularity and its capability to handle complex tasks like filling out web forms have raised market optimism about Meta AI's investment return potential.

Post added that cumulative U.S. downloads of Muse since launch have already outperformed other AI apps at the same point in time. According to Sensor Tower, Muse was downloaded 1.43 million times within 12 days, exceeding OpenAI's ChatGPT at 1.37 million and Google Gemini at 710,000.

Post cautioned that Muse's popularity may not translate into immediate revenue growth, saying "Muse's monetization paths—including ads, subscriptions and commission revenue—are unlikely to make a material contribution before 2028."

Nevertheless, Post remains optimistic about Meta's upcoming Watermelon model, believing it could deliver frontier‑level capabilities, improve Meta's core advertising business, and increase model‑hosting revenue.

items.title: 馬斯克：20年後可能有1,000億台人形機器人
items.title_en: Musk: In 20 years there could be 100 billion humanoid robots
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克接受《央視》專訪，談及機器人，他認為未來每個人都能擁有專屬機器人，這些機器人可以照料年邁父母，看護孩童，還能擔任孩子一對一私教，承擔各類工作。
馬斯克說，未來一個人可以操控成百上千台甚至上萬台實體機器人和數位智慧體。
「我的預測是十年內至少有10億台人形機器人，未來15年或許達到100億台，未來20年可能達到1,000億台。」馬斯克說。
paras_en: Tesla CEO Elon Musk in an interview with CCTV discussed robots, saying everyone could have a personal robot that can care for elderly parents, look after children, and even serve as a one‑on‑one tutor, handling various tasks.
Musk said that in the future a person could control hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of physical robots and digital intelligences.
“My prediction is that within ten years there will be at least 1 billion humanoid robots, in fifteen years perhaps 10 billion, and in twenty years possibly 100 billion,” Musk said.

items.title: 蘋果即將加入輝達5兆美元俱樂部？分析師這樣看
items.title_en: Apple Poised to Join Nvidia's $5 Trillion Club? Analysts Weigh In
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，隨著市場對蘋果(AAPL-US)新款iPhone與AI策略的期待升溫，蘋果正逐步逼近一項重大里程碑。
蘋果股價周二(22日)盤中創下345.34美元歷史新高，之後收在339.75美元，市值達到4.96兆美元。根據道瓊市場數據，蘋果股價在盤中一度突破5兆美元市值門檻。
今年稍早，蘋果也曾在7月28日及29日盤中交易期間觸及5兆美元市值里程碑。
截至目前，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)是唯一一家收盤市值突破5兆美元的公司。不過，一些分析師對蘋果股價持續走高抱持信心，尤其是隨著iPhone 18周期逐步展開。美銀分析師Wamsi Mohan給予蘋果370美元目標價，明顯高於使蘋果市值達到5兆美元所需的342.60美元目標價。
蘋果近期產品發表後市場熱情升溫，推動股價自本月初以來上漲7.2%。在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)帶領下，蘋果推出iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max，以及首款摺疊iPhone Duo。蘋果也透過iOS 27與Mac OS 27更新，陸續推出最新的Apple Intelligence功能。
分析師認為，摺疊手機的推出擴大了蘋果的整體潛在市場規模(TAM)，並可能隨著時間推進獲得主流市場採用。
Mohan在9月9日產品發布後的報告中寫道，「Duo在經過長時間後帶來了具意義的外型變化，並將硬體與軟體無縫整合。」
摩根大通分析師Samik Chatterjee認為，即使蘋果提高手機售價，仍能透過租賃方案、舊機換購及電信商補貼維持正向的銷量周期。他在本月的一份報告中寫道，iPhone Duo「令人印象深刻的功能展現」，也讓蘋果在高階產品上具備潛在的銷量上行空間。
除了近期的硬體產品發布外，相較於其他投入數千億美元建設資料中心基礎設施的大型科技公司，蘋果在AI領域採取了更為審慎的策略。
這項策略也為投資人帶來回報。今年以來，蘋果股價已上漲25%，相比之下，Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGS-US)上漲10%，標普500指數則上漲13.4%。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that as market anticipation heats up for Apple’s (AAPL-US) new iPhone and AI strategy, the company is gradually closing in on a major milestone.

Apple’s stock hit a record high of $345.34 intraday on Tuesday the 22nd, later closing at $339.75, giving it a market value of $4.96 trillion. According to Dow Jones market data, the stock briefly breached the $5 trillion market‑cap threshold during the session.
Earlier this year Apple also touched the $5 trillion market‑cap mark during intraday trading on July 28 and 29.

To date Nvidia (NVDA-US) remains the only company whose closing market value has surpassed $5 trillion. Nonetheless, several analysts remain confident that Apple’s stock can keep climbing, especially as the iPhone 18 cycle unfolds. Bank of America analyst Wamsi Mohan has a $370 price target for Apple, well above the $342.60 target needed to push the market cap to $5 trillion.

Following Apple’s recent product launch, market enthusiasm surged, driving the stock up 7.2% since the start of the month. Under new CEO John Ternus, Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, as well as its first foldable iPhone Duo. Apple also rolled out the latest Apple Intelligence features via iOS 27 and macOS 27 updates.
Analysts say the introduction of a foldable phone expands Apple’s total addressable market and could, over time, gain mainstream adoption.
Mohan wrote in a report after the September 9 product launch, “The Duo, after a long development period, brings a meaningful form‑factor change and seamlessly integrates hardware and software.”

JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee believes that even if Apple raises handset prices, it can still sustain a positive sales cycle through leasing programs, trade‑in offers, and carrier subsidies. In a report this month he described the iPhone Duo’s “impressive feature showcase,” giving Apple upside potential in its premium segment.
Beyond the recent hardware releases, Apple’s AI strategy is more cautious compared with other large tech firms that are spending hundreds of billions building data‑center infrastructure.
That strategy has rewarded investors. So far this year Apple’s stock is up 25%, versus a 10% rise for the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) and a 13.4% gain for the S&P 500 index.

items.title: Meta Muse爆紅顛覆消費習慣？AI代理人幫管錢與訂房 華爾街急拋金融旅遊股
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Goes Viral, Disrupting Consumer Habits? AI Agent Helps Manage Money and Book Hotels, Wall Street Dumps Financial and Travel Stocks
paras: Meta(META-US)新推出的人工智慧(AI)代理「Muse」帶動科技股重現人工智慧(AI)熱潮、助那斯達克綜合指數創下歷史新高，但也再度掀起AI顛覆和取代恐慌，金融領域當中的財富管理公司、券商甚至大型銀行股周二(22日)紛紛遭拋售，旅遊股也倒地不起。
標普500指數周二收在略低於平盤水準，標普500金融類股下跌2%，嘉信理財(Charles Schwab)(SCHW-US)、LPL Financial(LPLA-US)、Raymond James(RJF-US)、Ameriprise Financial(AMP-US)股價都下跌超過5%。
此外，美國最大銀行摩根大通(JPM-US)下跌3.4%，創7月以來最大單月跌幅，富國銀行(WFC-US)下跌3.9%，創5月以來最種跌幅，美國銀行(BAC-US)和花旗集團(C-US)以及全美多家中小型銀行股同步走低。
旅遊產業方面，網站業者Booking Holdings(BKNG-US)與好事達保險公司(Allstate)(ALL-US)也受到衝擊。

Muse爆紅 年初的AI顛覆疑慮捲土重來

Muse可以幫助用戶完成各種任務，包括預約、旅行、下訂單以及代表用戶發送電子郵件和訊息，而其所掀起的震盪，與今年稍早金融科技公司Altruist推出個人化節稅策略工具時出現的金融股賣壓如出一轍：人們擔心AI會取代傳統產業。
不過分析師表示，Muse已與支付商PayPal(PYPL-US)及金融科技公司Plaid等業者合作，代表潛在影響範圍更廣，可能改變消費者支付、財務規劃、保險保障等許多基本面向。
此外，Meta旗下各款應用程式目前擁有數十億用戶，這項既有的龐大用戶基礎更可能成為Muse推廣的助力。
Citizens金融服務與金融科技研究主管Devin Ryan表示，並不是任何單一AI代理人就能在一夜之間顛覆整個產業，但近幾個月來一連串類似產品的推出，「讓以下說法逐漸成形：世界正在改變，而隨著世界改變，不確定性也在增加」。
這項威脅對金融公司的影響，不只是機器人可能取代部分人類顧問與其收取的費用。在Ryan看來，AI代理人最終可能協助客戶更有效率的調度資金，讓券商等金融公司可以拿來創造自身利潤的閒置現金減少。
Ryan說：「如果一個代理人可以24小時全年無休的優化，這是否會讓金融體系中的閒置現金消失？」

傳統金融業仍有資料優勢

投資人與顧問提醒，華爾街對Muse的反應最終仍可能逆轉，一旦既有金融業者跟上科技變革，市場看法也可能改變。
為財富管理公司提供諮詢服務的Pirker Partners創辦人Alois Pirker說：「如果你經營的是一艘遠洋巨輪，不可能明天就把它掉頭。」他指出，這對這些金融公司而言是「巨大的機會」，因為「當然，他們確實擁有所有資料」。
Anthropic上周推出一套Claude工作流程工具，可串接嘉信理財與Vanguard等公司所運行的平台。
Gabelli Funds投資組合經理Macrae Sykes說：「如果嘉信理財能協助顧問提高生產力，讓顧問能提供更好的建議並吸引更多資產，最終將透過託管、客戶互動等業務，讓公司受益。」
不過就目前而言，金融業本來就因為「利率居高不下」對放款業務的打壓而低迷，現在又因為這波創新，讓華爾街對金融股的熱情進一步減退。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) has launched a new artificial intelligence (AI) agent called "Muse," reigniting the AI rally in tech stocks and helping the Nasdaq Composite hit a record high, but it also sparked fresh fears of AI disruption and replacement. Wealth‑management firms, brokerages and even large banks saw their shares sold off on Tuesday (the 22nd), and travel stocks tumbled as well.

The S&P 500 closed Tuesday just below its flat‑line level, with S&P 500 financial stocks down 2%. Charles Schwab (SCHW-US), LPL Financial (LPLA-US), Raymond James (RJF-US) and Ameriprise Financial (AMP-US) each fell more than 5%.

JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) dropped 3.4%, marking its biggest monthly decline since July, Wells Fargo (WFC-US) slid 3.9%, its steepest fall since May, and Bank of America (BAC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and a host of regional U.S. banks also moved lower.
In the travel sector, website operator Booking Holdings (BKNG-US) and insurer Allstate (ALL-US) were also hit.

Muse’s viral popularity revives early‑year AI disruption worries. The agent can handle tasks such as scheduling appointments, planning trips, placing orders and sending emails or messages on a user’s behalf, and the market reaction mirrors the sell‑off in financial stocks that followed fintech firm Altruist’s launch of a personalized tax‑saving tool earlier this year: investors fear AI will replace traditional businesses.

Analysts note that Muse has already partnered with payment provider PayPal (PYPL-US) and fintech firm Plaid, suggesting a broader potential impact that could reshape consumer payments, financial planning, insurance coverage and other fundamentals.
Moreover, Meta’s suite of apps already boasts billions of users, a massive existing base that could further accelerate Muse’s adoption.

Citizens Financial Services and fintech research head Devin Ryan said no single AI agent can overturn an entire industry overnight, but the string of similar product launches in recent months is shaping the narrative that the world is changing and, with that change, uncertainty is rising.

The threat to financial firms isn’t just that robots might replace some human advisors and their fees. Ryan believes AI agents could eventually help clients allocate capital more efficiently, reducing the idle cash that brokerages and other financial firms currently use to generate profit.
Ryan asked, “If an agent can optimize 24/7, year‑round, could that eliminate idle cash in the financial system?”

Traditional finance still holds a data advantage. Investors and advisors caution that Wall Street’s reaction to Muse could reverse once incumbent financial players catch up with the tech shift, potentially altering market sentiment.

Alois Pirker, founder of Pirker Partners, which advises wealth‑management firms, said, “If you’re steering a massive ocean liner, you can’t turn it around overnight.” He called the situation a “huge opportunity” for these firms because “they do, after all, own all the data.”
Anthropic unveiled a Claude workflow tool last week that can integrate with platforms run by firms such as Charles Schwab and Vanguard.

Macrae Sykes, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said, “If Charles Schwab can help advisors boost productivity, deliver better advice and attract more assets, the firm will ultimately benefit through custody, client‑interaction and other services.”

However, the financial sector is already sluggish due to “persistently high interest rates” squeezing loan businesses, and this wave of innovation is further dampening Wall Street’s enthusiasm for financial stocks.

items.title: 標普500逼近新高、個股卻頻創新低 美股浮現1999年式罕見背離 岡拉克怎麼操作？
items.title_en: S&P 500 Nears New Highs While Individual Stocks Frequently Hit New Lows, U.S. Stocks Show Rare 1999‑Era Divergence – How Gundlach Is Acting
paras: 美股主要指數近期持續逼近歷史高點，但指數表面強勢之下，個股表現卻出現罕見分化。9月21日交易中，標普500指數上漲1.49%, 收在7,764.70點，距離歷史高點不到1%, 同日那斯達克綜合指數上漲約2%, 創下收盤新高。然而，標普500成分股中卻有30檔股票觸及52週新低, 僅7檔創下52週新高，形成指數上漲與市場廣度惡化並存的異常格局。
更值得注意的是，若將觀察區間從52週擴大至60日及120日，市場內部弱勢程度同樣明顯。最新統計顯示，標普500成分股中，近3個交易日創60日新低的股票達99檔，創60日新高的僅28檔；創120日新低的股票達77檔，創120日新高的僅22檔。換言之，即使指數已經逼近歷史高點，個股層面的下跌壓力仍然廣泛存在。

這種現象被市場策略師視為「市場廣度」與指數走勢之間的重大背離。9月21日的特殊之處並不只是新低股票多於新高股票，而是標普500單日上漲至少1%, 同時距離歷史高點不到1%, 卻仍出現新低股多於新高股的組合。SentimenTrader創辦人、NextGen News顧問Jason Goepfert指出，往前追溯近百年，符合這組條件的前一次案例是1999年12月21日, 更早則是1929年7月23日。
不過，這項歷史比較本身並不代表市場即將重演1929年或1999年的走勢。兩個歷史案例距離後續市場重大轉折都有數月時間，而且樣本極少，因此更適合作為市場廣度異常的歷史參照，而非單獨用來判斷後市方向。
目前的另一個警訊是指數內部的參與程度。近期資料顯示，標普500成分股中，站在50日移動平均線之上的股票比例不到30%, 顯示推動指數上漲的股票數量相對有限。換言之，標普500指數仍然具有韌性，但指數上漲並未同步擴散至大部分成分股。

從產業結構來看，近期漲勢主要集中在資訊科技、通訊服務及非必需消費品等板塊。其中資訊科技類股距離52週高點不到1%, 但通訊服務及非必需消費品仍分別落後各自高點約4%及7%。B. Riley Financial (RILY-US)旗下B. Riley Wealth首席市場策略師Art Hogan表示，市場領漲板塊目前正努力抵抗板塊輪動帶來的壓力，而已經遭到拋售的股票，由於距離前低較近，因此形成新低的難度反而較低。
Hogan同時指出，如果中東局勢持續影響市場情緒，類似的市場廣度分化可能在未來幾個月間零星出現。他認為，若戰事持續、能源價格維持高位, 同時聯準會需要維持偏緊縮的利率政策, 市場要再創歷史新高將面臨更大阻力。近期市場也持續受到中東局勢、油價及利率預期牽動。9月22日交易中，標普500小幅走弱, 道瓊工業指數下跌逾290點, 金融股成為主要拖累，而市場仍關注油價接近每桶100美元所帶來的通膨壓力。
市場情緒同樣出現變化。不過，原稿所稱高盛情緒指標最新降至負0.9需要加以釐清。高盛研究資料顯示，美國市場情緒指標曾在3月底降至負0.9, 隨後回升至正0.8, 因此負0.9並非目前最新讀數。
在市場廣度出現異常之際, DoubleLine Capital創辦人兼執行長傑佛瑞・岡拉克(Jeffrey Gundlach)則進一步將焦點放在人工智慧交易。他以2007年美國房地產泡沫判斷而受到市場關注，近期表示自己正在盡可能降低投資組合對AI交易的曝險，並直言「我只想退出」。不過，岡拉克也強調，他並非全面拋售股票，也沒有放空AI相關股票，而是希望遠離他認為可能承受最大損失的市場區域。
岡拉克認為，AI投資敘事已經從「一切都很美好」的階段轉向投資人開始重新檢視風險。他指出，市場過去對AI能力及商業前景抱持高度樂觀態度，但如今開始出現對技術能力、資本支出及企業融資需求的疑問。岡拉克並表示，AI交易何時真正出現崩跌，他自己也無法確定，但認為市場已經接近需要更加謹慎看待的階段。
他尤其關注AI相關企業快速增加的資本需求及信用市場變化，認為企業為了AI基礎建設而大量借貸，可能在利率或資金成本上升時放大金融市場風險。此外，他也提到SpaceX潛在市場規模的龐大估值。市場報導指出，馬斯克曾將相關潛在市場規模估計為28.5兆美元。岡拉克認為，如果少數企業最終占據如此龐大的AI市場，市場利益不可能平均分配，因此AI競賽中勢必會出現失敗者。
在最新的資產配置建議中，岡拉克已將股票配置建議由40%降至30%, 並偏向等權重標普500類型的股票配置，以降低大型AI及科技股在傳統市值加權指數中的集中度。他另外建議配置30%固定收益資產、20%實體資產, 包括黃金及商品策略, 以及20%「乾粉」資產。
岡拉克同時指出，標普500的Shiller本益比週期調整指標目前已高於42, 並表示過去當該指標高於35時，後續10年的實質報酬均曾呈現負值。不過，這屬於歷史估值觀察，並不代表未來市場必然按照相同模式發展。
整體而言，當前美股呈現兩個同時存在的訊號：一方面，標普500及那斯達克仍受到大型科技及AI相關股票帶動，指數甚至逼近或刷新歷史高點；另一方面，越來越多個股跌至不同時間區間的新低，市場上漲的參與範圍明顯收窄。這意味著目前美股的「指數強勢」與「個股廣度疲弱」正在同時存在。
因此，近期市場真正受到關注的並非單純是標普500能否再創新高，而是支撐指數的領漲股票能否進一步擴散，以及先前落後的股票能否停止持續創造新低。若市場廣度持續惡化，即使指數仍能依靠少數大型權值股維持高位，市場內部的結構性分化仍可能成為後續波動的重要來源。
paras_en: U.S. equity indices have been edging toward historic peaks, yet beneath the headline strength the stocks themselves are showing a rare split. On September 21 the S&P 500 rose 1.49% to close at 7,764.70, less than 1% shy of its all‑time high, while the Nasdaq Composite jumped about 2% to a fresh closing record. However, among the S&P 500 constituents 30 stocks hit 52‑week lows and only seven made 52‑week highs, creating an abnormal mix of index gains and worsening market breadth.

The picture deepens when the window is widened beyond 52 weeks to 60‑day and 120‑day periods. The latest count shows 99 S&P 500 components posted 60‑day lows in the past three trading days versus just 28 making 60‑day highs; 77 stocks hit 120‑day lows compared with only 22 reaching 120‑day highs. In other words, even as the index nears its record, downward pressure on individual stocks remains widespread.

Market strategists label this a major divergence between market breadth and the index’s trajectory. What makes September 21 special is not merely that more stocks made new lows than new highs, but that the S&P 500 rose at least 1% in a day while still being under 1% from its record, yet still saw more new‑low than new‑high stocks. Jason Goepfert, founder of SentimenTrader and NextGen News advisor, notes that the last time this exact combination occurred was December 21, 1999, with an even earlier instance on July 23, 1929.

Nevertheless, the historical comparison does not imply a repeat of the 1929 crash or the 1999 rally. In both cases the market turned several months later, and such instances are extremely rare, so they serve better as a reference for abnormal breadth rather than a direct forecast of future direction.

Another warning sign is the depth of participation inside the index. Recent data show that fewer than 30% of S&P 500 constituents are trading above their 50‑day moving average, indicating that relatively few stocks are actually driving the index higher. In short, the S&P 500 remains resilient, but its gains are not broadly shared across its components.

Sector‑wise, the recent rally has been led by information technology, communication services and consumer discretionary. Tech stocks are less than 1% away from their 52‑week highs, while communication services and consumer discretionary lag their peaks by roughly 4% and 7% respectively. Art Hogan, chief market strategist for B. Riley Wealth, says the leading sectors are fighting off sector‑rotation pressure, and stocks that have already been sold off find it easier to make new lows because they sit close to recent troughs.

Hogan adds that if Middle‑East tensions continue to affect sentiment, similar pockets of breadth divergence could appear sporadically over the next few months. He believes that prolonged conflict, high energy prices and a still‑tight Fed policy would make it harder for the market to set fresh all‑time highs. The market is already feeling the pull of Middle‑East developments, oil prices and rate expectations – on September 22 the S&P 500 slipped slightly, the Dow fell over 290 points, financials dragged, and investors remain wary of oil nearing $100 a barrel and the inflation pressure it brings.

Market mood has also shifted. The article’s claim that Goldman Sachs’ sentiment index has fallen to –0.9 needs clarification: Goldman’s research shows the U.S. sentiment gauge hit –0.9 at the end of March, then rebounded to +0.8, so –0.9 is not the current reading.

Amid the breadth anomaly, DoubleLine Capital founder and CEO Jeffrey Gundlach has turned his focus to AI trading. Known for his 2007‑era real‑estate bubble call, Gundlach recently said he is trimming exposure to AI‑driven strategies and bluntly declared, “I just want out.” He stresses he is not dumping all equities nor shorting AI stocks, but is stepping away from what he sees as the market segment most likely to suffer the biggest losses.

Gundlach argues the AI investment narrative has moved from “everything is wonderful” to a phase where investors are reassessing risk. He notes that while the market once held an overly optimistic view of AI’s capabilities and commercial prospects, doubts are now surfacing about the technology’s performance, capital‑intensive spending and corporate financing needs. He admits he cannot pinpoint when AI‑driven trading might truly crash, but believes the market is approaching a point that warrants greater caution.

He is especially watching the rapid rise in capital demand from AI‑related firms and shifts in credit markets, warning that heavy borrowing for AI infrastructure could amplify financial‑system risk if rates or funding costs rise. He also referenced SpaceX’s massive potential market, citing Elon Musk’s own estimate of a $28.5 trillion addressable market. Gundlach warns that if only a handful of firms capture such a huge AI pie, the gains will be uneven and losers will inevitably emerge in the AI race.

In his latest asset‑allocation guidance, Gundlach cut his equity allocation from 40% to 30% and tilted toward an equal‑weight S&P 500 style basket to reduce concentration in large AI and tech names within the traditional market‑cap weighted index. He also recommends 30% fixed income, 20% real assets—including gold and commodity strategies—and 20% “dry powder” cash‑like assets.

Gundlach also points out that the cyclically adjusted Shiller P/E for the S&P 500 is now above 42, and historically, when that metric exceeded 35, the subsequent ten‑year real returns were negative. He cautions that this is a historical valuation observation and does not guarantee the same outcome going forward.

Overall, U.S. equities are sending two simultaneous signals: on one hand, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are being buoyed by large‑cap tech and AI stocks, pushing the indices toward or past historic highs; on the other hand, an increasing number of individual stocks are sinking to new lows across various time frames, narrowing the breadth of participation in the rally. This means the market’s “index strength” coexists with “weak stock‑level breadth.”

Consequently, the focus is shifting from whether the S&P 500 can make another record to whether the leading stocks that are driving the index can broaden their influence and whether lagging stocks can stop spiraling to new lows. If breadth continues to deteriorate, even a high‑flying index supported by a few heavyweight names could mask underlying structural divergence that may fuel future volatility.

items.title: AI產業有多大？OpenAI、Anthropic與SpaceX估值竟超越45年科技IPO總值
items.title_en: How Big Is the AI Industry? Valuations of OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX Surpass the Total Value of Tech IPOs Over the Past 45 Years
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，如果你想知道AI產業進軍公開市場的規模究竟有多龐大，只要看看這個領域最大幾家公司的估值就知道了。
以OpenAI為例，該公司正以1.2兆美元估值籌募資金，再加上Anthropic上市時可能達到的2兆美元估值，以及SpaceX(SPCX-US)目前2兆美元的市值，三家公司合計已超過5兆美元。
這個數字已經超過1980年至2025年所有首次公開募股(IPO)的總市值。《金融時報》援引佛羅里達大學Warrington商學院名譽教授Jay Ritter的數據指出了這點。
談話節目Morning Joe經濟分析師、《紐約時報》專欄撰稿人Steve Rattner在X上發布的一張圖表中，呈現了這些估值。他也指出，歷史數據並未經過通膨調整。
Anthropic與OpenAI是全球規模最大、技術最先進的兩家AI實驗室之一，旗下分別擁有Claude與GPT模型系列。
由Dario Amodei帶領的Anthropic預計將在下個月某個時間上市，但也可能延後至今年秋季稍晚。OpenAI原本也預計今年上市，但目前將IPO目標時間定在2027年。
這些公司的龐大估值，顯示早期投資人與華爾街對AI能否實現市場期待抱有多大信心。多位科技業高層曾將這項技術的重要性比擬為火或網際網路的出現。
這三家公司也讓生產AI模型所需GPU與記憶體晶片的硬體公司，成為AI產業中不可或缺的一環。
以輝達(NVDA-US)為例，截至周二，其市值達到5.5兆美元。而美光(MU-US)股價則在過去兩年已飆升超過1,100%。
不過，AI公司也正面臨一系列挑戰，包括外界擔心這項技術可能傷害人類。此外，網路犯罪分子與威權政權可能濫用AI模型為自身目的服務，也是目前疑慮。
Amodei上周呼籲AI研究公司放慢高階AI模型的開發速度，導致相關企業股價走低。不過，從本周截至目前的市場表現來看，投資人似乎還沒有準備放棄這波AI熱潮。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that if you want to gauge how massive the AI industry's entry into public markets really is, just look at the valuations of the sector's biggest companies.

Take OpenAI as an example: the company is raising capital at a $1.2 trillion valuation, plus the roughly $2 trillion valuation Anthropic could achieve when it goes public, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) currently valued at $2 trillion, together exceeding $5 trillion.

That figure already surpasses the total market value of all initial public offerings (IPOs) from 1980 to 2025. The Financial Times cited data from Jay Ritter, a distinguished professor at the Warrington College of Business, University of Florida, to highlight this point.

In a chart posted on X by Morning Joe economic analyst and New York Times columnist Steve Rattner, these valuations are displayed. He also noted that the historical data have not been adjusted for inflation.
Anthropic and OpenAI are two of the world’s largest and most advanced AI labs, each operating the Claude and GPT model families respectively.

Anthropic, led by Dario Amodei, plans to go public sometime next month, though the timeline could slip to later this fall. OpenAI had originally aimed for a 2024 IPO but has now set its target for 2027.

The huge valuations of these firms show how much confidence early investors and Wall Street have in AI’s ability to meet market expectations. Several tech executives have compared the technology’s significance to the advent of fire or the internet.
These three companies also make hardware makers that produce GPUs and memory chips essential for training AI models an indispensable part of the AI ecosystem.
Take Nvidia (NVDA-US) as an example: as of Tuesday its market cap reached $5.5 trillion. Meanwhile, Micron (MU-US) shares have surged more than 1,100 % over the past two years.

However, AI firms are facing a slew of challenges, including concerns that the technology could harm humanity. Cybercriminals and authoritarian regimes may also misuse AI models for their own purposes, which remains a current worry.

Amodei called last week for AI research companies to slow down the development of advanced AI models, which knocked down related stock prices. Yet, based on market performance so far this week, investors don’t seem ready to abandon the AI boom.

items.title: 2027年全美大學排名出爐！ 指標迎歷史級重塑首納「就業回報」　普林斯頓15年神話破滅、MIT登頂
items.title_en: 2027 U.S. College Rankings Released! Metrics Undergo Historic Overhaul, Adding “Employment Return” for the First Time – Princeton’s 15‑Year Reign Ends, MIT Takes the Top Spot
paras: 《美國新聞與世界報導》公布2027全美最佳大學排名，麻省理工學院(MIT)首度登頂，打破普林斯頓自2012年版起連續15年霸榜格局。
根據最新排名，綜合大學前十名依序為MIT、普林斯頓、哈佛、耶魯，加州理工學院與史丹佛大學並列第五，賓大第七，杜克第八，約翰霍普金斯、西北、芝加哥並列第九。哥倫比亞、達特茅斯第十二，卡內基梅隆、康乃爾第十四。
《美國新聞與世界報導》表示，改版回應了學費高漲與投報率疑慮。對申請家庭而言，單看綜合名次已不夠，選校應同時核對目標專業薪資、畢業率、低收入生支持與地區產業連結，避免被短期洗牌誤導。
這項最新排名被教育界稱為近十年最顛覆，主因在指標重構。首先，排名首度納入「分專業畢業收入」，沿用美國教育部College Scorecard畢業4年各學門實際薪資，按領域同類對比，取代原有畢業負債指標，此舉對電腦、工程、量化金融就業轉化強的學校是利多，也是MIT登頂關鍵。
其次，「學生產出成果」權重逾50%，含畢業率、大一留校率、佩爾獎學金學生社會流動與起薪等硬指標。第三，卡內基分類調整，約20%學校重新分組，商科、工科、醫學專項校首度更完整納入綜合評比，歷史名次不宜直接縱比。第四，佩爾獎學金學生占比與畢業轉化權重上升，成為前25名拉鋸重點。
文理學院方面，威廉斯、阿默斯特續分列榜首與探花；公立學校以柏克萊、UCLA並列最佳，聖路易華盛頓大學、范德堡、萊斯等十六名群聚。
整體排名給出的信號是從「聲譽與資源」轉向「就業回報與社會流動」的排名。
paras_en: U.S. News & World Report released the 2027 Best Colleges ranking, with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) topping the list for the first time, ending Princeton’s 15‑year streak that began with the 2012 edition.

According to the latest ranking, the top ten schools overall are, in order: MIT, Princeton, Harvard, Yale, Caltech and Stanford tied for fifth, Penn in seventh, Duke in eighth, Johns Hopkins, Northwestern and Chicago tied for ninth. Columbia and Dartmouth are twelfth, Carnegie Mellon and Cornell are fourteenth.

U.S. News & World Report said the redesign responds to soaring tuition and concerns about return on investment. For applicant families, looking only at the overall rank is no longer enough; school selection should also verify target‑major salaries, graduation rates, low‑income student support and regional industry connections to avoid being misled by short‑term shuffles.

The new ranking has been called the most disruptive in a decade, mainly because of the metric overhaul. For the first time it includes “major‑specific graduate earnings,” using the Department of Education’s College Scorecard data on four‑year post‑graduation salaries by discipline, compared within fields, replacing the previous debt‑based metric. This benefits schools strong in computer science, engineering and quantitative finance and was a key factor in MIT’s ascent.

In addition, “student outcomes” now carry more than 50% weight, encompassing graduation rates, first‑year retention, Pell‑Grant student social mobility and starting salaries, among other hard indicators. A third change is the adjustment of Carnegie classifications, with about 20% of schools re‑grouped; business, engineering and medical specialty schools are now fully incorporated into the overall assessment, making historical rank comparisons inappropriate. A fourth change is the increased weight on the proportion of Pell‑Grant students and graduation conversion, making these metrics a focal point in the battle for the top 25 spots.

In the liberal‑arts segment, Williams and Amherst continue to occupy the top two spots, while public institutions Berkeley and UCLA tie as the best public schools. Washington University in St. Louis, Vanderbilt, Rice and other schools make up a cluster of sixteen institutions in the middle of the list.
The overall signal of the ranking is a shift from emphasizing “reputation and resources” to focusing on “employment return and social mobility.”

items.title: 高市早苗與川普紐約會晤 川習會前夕鞏固日美同盟
items.title_en: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi Meets Trump in New York, Reinforcing the Japan‑US Alliance Ahead of the Japan‑US Summit
paras: 日本首相高市早苗於美東時間周二(22日)利用出席聯合國大會期間，在紐約與美國總統川普舉行約35分鐘的雙邊會談。由於美中首腦會談即將於兩天後登場，此次會晤成為日美雙方提前對焦中國政策的重要時機。
會前面對媒體時，高市早苗強調，在亞洲安全環境日益嚴峻之際，期盼透過會談「向世界展現日美同盟的堅韌」。川普則公開讚揚高市早苗「做得非常出色」，並提及日本產業與國家發展良好，肯定她「會是一位偉大的首相」。
談及經濟安全時，高市早苗表示：「歸功於川普與我個人的領導力，雙方在人工智慧(AI)、半導體及關鍵礦物等領域的經濟安全合作已穩步推進。」對於日中局勢，川普則回應「當然會討論」。
日本內閣官房副長官尾崎正直在會後說明，兩國領袖針對包含經濟安全在內的中國相關課題進行討論，並同意緊密合作。尾崎正直強調，在美中峰會前夕，「日美成功在最佳時機展現了同盟的強固性」。
會談還討論了國際刑事法院(ICC)問題。由於美方對ICC高層(包含首位日籍所長赤根智子)實施制裁，川普更在聯合國演說中抨擊ICC為「反美法庭」，呼籲各國退出。對此，日本政府高層官員與尾崎正直表示，高市早苗向川普說明了日本「始終支持ICC以落實國際社會法治」的立場，雙方進行了率直的意見交換。
此外，高市早苗在聯合國大會演說中，特別呼籲應儘速廢除聯合國憲章中的「舊敵國條款」。高市引述2005年全體加盟國首腦達成決議的共識，主張此條款「應早日刪除」。
此舉在回應先前中國對日方的批判，中國外交部發言人毛寧日前曾主張條款持續有效，並要求日方「應以史為鑑，與軍國主義徹底切割」。
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi used her attendance at the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday (the 22nd, Eastern Time) to hold a roughly 35‑minute bilateral meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump in New York. With the U.S.–China summit scheduled for two days later, the meeting served as an early opportunity for the two sides to focus on China policy.

Before the meeting, Takaichi told the media that, amid an increasingly severe security environment in Asia, she hopes the talks will “show the world the resilience of the Japan‑U.S. alliance.” Trump publicly praised Takaichi as “doing an excellent job,” noted the health of Japanese industry and national development, and affirmed that she “will be a great prime minister.”

Discussing economic security, Takaichi said, “Thanks to the leadership of President Trump and myself, cooperation on economic security in AI, semiconductors and critical minerals has been steadily advancing.” When asked about the Japan‑China situation, Trump replied, “Of course we’ll discuss it.”

Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Masanao Ozaki explained after the meeting that the two leaders discussed China‑related issues, including economic security, and agreed to work closely together. Ozaki stressed that, on the eve of the U.S.–China summit, “Japan‑U.S. relations have successfully demonstrated the strength of the alliance at the optimal moment.”

The talks also covered the International Criminal Court (ICC). Because the United States has imposed sanctions on senior ICC officials, including the first Japanese director‑general Tomoko Akane, Trump denounced the ICC in his UN speech as an “anti‑U.S. court” and called on countries to withdraw. Japanese senior officials, represented by Ozaki, said Takaichi conveyed Japan’s position that it “continues to support the ICC in upholding the rule of law in the international community,” and the two sides exchanged frank views.

In her UN General Assembly speech, Takaichi specifically called for the prompt removal of the “former enemy state” clause from the UN Charter. She cited the consensus reached in a 2005 resolution by all member‑state heads and argued that the clause “should be deleted as soon as possible.”

The move responds to earlier Chinese criticism of Japan. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning recently argued that the clause should remain in force and urged Japan to “learn from history and completely sever ties with militarism.”

items.title: 川普支持禁止出口柴油對抗通膨 專家擔憂恐反重傷全球能源市場
items.title_en: Trump Backs Diesel Export Ban to Fight Inflation, Experts Warn It Could Severely Harm Global Energy Market
paras: 因應全球供應短缺導致柴油價格飆升，美國總統川普周二(22日)表示支持實施柴油出口禁令，期盼藉此壓低國內能源價格。然而，市場分析師與業界團體普遍警告，出口禁令非但無法解決高油價，反而會劇烈衝擊全球燃料市場。
根據美國汽車協會(AAA)數據，美國柴油平均售價已創下每加侖 6.51 美元的新高。柴油作為運輸、農業及工業製造的核心燃料，高昂成本正推升通膨壓力，成為期中選舉前夕的焦點議題。
由於烏克蘭空襲俄羅斯煉油廠及美伊戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽航運受阻，全球對美柴依賴大幅提升，美國 8 月柴油日出口量高達 160 萬桶。儘管美國煉油廠產能利用率達 97%，國內柴油庫存仍較5年同期平均低了近 13%。
針對出口禁令可能帶來的衝擊，美國石油學會(API)發表聲明指出，限制柴油出口將「對國內外燃料市場造成嚴重破壞、引發煉油作業動盪，並加劇全球煉油危機」。API 強調，墨西哥灣沿岸煉油廠產量雖高於當地需求，但受限於地理與基礎設施，多餘柴油無法直接轉運至其他缺油的美國區域。
能源經濟學家Philip Verleger分析，由於柴油需求價格彈性極低，禁令初期將推動全球油價飆漲，甚至可能暴漲高達 100%。他更警告，此舉將重蹈 1973 年尼克森總統黃豆禁運的覆轍，使國際社會不再視美國為可靠的供應國，損害長期信用。
貝克公共政策研究所學者Kenneth Medlock III指出，封鎖出口市場會促使煉油廠降低原油加工量，因為沒有業者會虧本銷售。即便禁令短期內可能短暫壓低國內價格，但效應絕對無法持久。
Wood Mackenzie 諮詢公司石油交易分析總監Jim Mitchell則認為，禁令呼聲「政治宣示意味濃於實際現實」。他補充，歐洲結構性缺乏柴油且高度依賴美國供應，禁令將對美國的關鍵盟友造成嚴重傷害。
paras_en: In response to worldwide supply shortages that have driven diesel prices soaring, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that he supports implementing a diesel export ban, hoping it will lower domestic energy prices. However, market analysts and industry groups widely warn that such a ban will not solve high fuel prices and will instead sharply disrupt the global fuel market.

According to data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), the average U.S. diesel price has hit a new high of $6.51 per gallon. Diesel, a core fuel for transportation, agriculture and industrial manufacturing, is pushing inflation pressures higher and has become a focal issue ahead of the mid‑term elections.

Because Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and the U.S.–Iran war have disrupted shipping through the Hormuz Strait, global reliance on U.S. diesel has risen sharply, with U.S. diesel exports in August reaching 1.6 million barrels per day. Even though U.S. refinery capacity utilization is at 97%, domestic diesel inventories remain about 13% below the five‑year average for the same period.

Addressing the potential impact of an export ban, the American Petroleum Institute (API) issued a statement that restricting diesel exports would "cause severe disruption to domestic and foreign fuel markets, trigger turbulence in refining operations, and exacerbate the global refining crisis." API emphasized that while Gulf Coast refineries produce more than local demand, geographic and infrastructure constraints prevent excess diesel from being directly shipped to other U.S. regions that are short on supply.

Energy economist Philip Verleger noted that diesel demand has very low price elasticity, so an initial ban would likely send global oil prices soaring, potentially up to 100%. He warned the move could repeat the fallout from President Nixon’s 1973 soybean export ban, eroding confidence in the United States as a reliable supplier and damaging its long‑term credibility.

Kenneth Medlock III of the Brookings Institution said that blocking export markets would cause refineries to cut crude processing volumes because no operator would sell at a loss. Even if the ban temporarily nudges domestic prices lower, the effect would not be sustainable.

Jim Mitchell, head of oil trading analysis at Wood Mackenzie, argued that the ban is more a political statement than a practical solution. He added that Europe’s structural diesel shortage and heavy reliance on U.S. supplies mean the ban would seriously harm a key U.S. ally.

items.title: 花旗點名三大市場醞釀「空單回補」
items.title_en: Citi Flags Three Major Markets Ripe for Short Covering
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，花旗警告，全球股市投資人上週進一步降低風險部位，空頭部位在多個市場重新增加，尤以美國小型股、歐洲及部分亞洲市場最為明顯。目前部分空單已陷入虧損，一旦市場出現利多，日經指數、南韓 KOSPI 指數及標普 500 指數可能出現較大規模的空單回補行情。
由策略師 David Chew 領軍的花旗團隊指出，歐洲Stoxx 50指數及美國大型股的淨部位仍相對穩健，但投資人持續削減方向性風險，反映市場情緒轉弱。多個市場累積大量空頭部位，也使後續走勢呈現不對稱風險。
這波部位降溫發生在聯準會 (Fed) 3 年來首次升息、日本央行進一步調整政策、能源價格上漲及地緣政治緊張之際。花旗形容，這些因素共同引發本輪利率週期以來最同步的避險浪潮之一。
美國市場方面，三大主要股指均出現偏空資金流向，主要源自投資人新建空單，而非撤出多頭部位。其中，羅素 2000 指數的部位單週降幅居花旗追蹤的全球市場之首，目前所有剩餘多單都處於虧損。
相較之下，標普 500 指數及那斯達克指數展現較強韌性，持續出現的空單回補抵銷大部分偏空壓力。
花旗指出，標普 500 指數約 80% 的多單與空單目前均處於虧損，但由於空頭部位規模較大，市場風險明顯偏向空單回補。即使指數僅溫和反彈，也可能促使空頭平倉，帶來額外買盤。
歐洲方面，德國 DAX 指數及歐洲銀行股指數因新空單增加，部位轉為輕度偏空。歐洲斯托克指數雖出現區內最大規模的資金流出，整體部位仍保持偏多。
花旗認為，歐洲市場的主要風險正由方向判斷轉向部位壓力。多數指數的多頭部位已陷入虧損，其中 DAX 的損益結構在歐洲市場中最弱。
亞洲仍是全球部位最偏空的地區。日經指數的空頭傾向雖略有改善，但仍是主要市場中部位最偏空者；投資人也進一步增加南韓 KOSPI、香港恆生指數及中國 A50 指數的空單。
日經指數、KOSPI及恆生指數的空頭部位均接近歷史高檔，其中日經與KOSPI超過 40% 的空單已陷入虧損。花旗表示，任何正面催化劑都可能引發幅度不成比例的空單回補漲勢，日經指數面臨的風險尤其突出。
paras_en: Citi warned that global equity investors further reduced risk positions last week, short positions increased in several markets, especially U.S. small‑cap stocks, Europe and some Asian markets. Some shorts are now in loss; if the market receives positive news, the Nikkei, South Korea KOSPI and S&P 500 could see large short‑covering rallies.

Led by strategist David Chew, the Citi team said net positions in the European Stoxx 50 and U.S. large‑cap stocks remain relatively solid, but investors continue cutting directional risk, reflecting weaker market sentiment. Accumulated large short positions in many markets create asymmetric risk.

This cooling of positions occurs as the Fed implements its first rate hike in three years, the Bank of Japan further adjusts policy, energy prices rise and geopolitical tensions heighten. Citi describes these factors as sparking one of the most synchronized hedging waves of the current rate‑cycle.

In U.S. markets, all three major indices showed net short flows, mainly from investors opening new shorts rather than unwinding longs. The Russell 2000’s position fell the most in a single week among Citi‑tracked global markets, and all remaining long positions are now in loss.
By contrast, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq displayed greater resilience, with ongoing short covering offsetting most of the bearish pressure.

Citi notes that about 80% of both long and short positions in the S&P 500 are currently losing, but because short size is larger, market risk leans toward short covering. Even a modest rebound could trigger short liquidation and add buying pressure.

In Europe, Germany’s DAX and the European banking index turned lightly short as new shorts were added. The European Stoxx index saw the region’s biggest fund outflow, yet its overall position remains net long.

Citi believes the main risk in Europe is shifting from directional bets to position pressure. Most index long positions are in loss, with the DAX having the weakest profit‑loss structure among European markets.

Asia remains the most short‑biased region globally. The Nikkei’s short tilt has slightly improved but still is the most short‑biased among major markets; investors also added shorts on South Korea’s KOSPI, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng and China A50 indices.

Short positions in the Nikkei, KOSPI and Hang Seng are near historic highs, with over 40% of shorts on the Nikkei and KOSPI already in loss. Citi says any positive catalyst could spark a disproportionately large short‑covering rally, with the Nikkei’s risk especially pronounced.

items.title: AI助理Muse爆紅 會是Meta的「ChatGPT」時刻嗎？
items.title_en: AI Assistant Muse Goes Viral—Is This Meta's "ChatGPT" Moment?
paras: Meta(META-US)新推出的人工智慧(AI)助理Muse登上Apple美國App Store下載榜首，下載速度也超越ChatGPT早期表現，正在大幅提振市場對Meta AI策略的信心，也吸引華爾街投資人的目光。
與傳統聊天機器人不同，Muse旨在執行多步驟任務，例如預訂餐廳、撥打電話及寄送電子郵件。Muse的驚人熱度讓分析師更有信心認為，Meta將能運用深厚的社群媒體根基，在AI時代打造出爆紅應用程式。
摩根大通(JPMorgan)分析師Doug Anmuth周二(22日)說：「雖然還在早期階段，但我們認為，Muse有潛力成為自ChatGPT以來使用最廣泛的消費者AI應用程式。」
這對Meta而言是一次重要的突破，因為直到不久前，市場對Meta的AI策略和龐大的資本支出計畫，多半仍抱持懷疑態度。Muse推出後，Anmuth已經將Meta股票評級調升至「加碼」。
自9月初以來，Meta股價已上漲近30%，其中21%出現在Muse推出的短短兩周時間裡。
Anmuth指出，Muse具有多項優勢，包括介面容易上手、慷慨的免費方案，背後還有Meta在旗下各社群媒體平台上的龐大用戶群撐腰。
Anmuth進一步表示，Meta近期也加快AI產品推出速度，例如AI模型短短幾個月內能力就大幅躍升。Meta在7月推出Muse Spark 1.1，是Meta首次發布具備接近前沿水準程式設計能力的AI模型。
Meta開發者大會「Meta Connect」將於本周三(23日)起一連舉行兩天，Anmuth預期，Meta將進一步更新AI進展，以及Muse如何與合作夥伴和Meta硬體整合。

下一代模型Watermelon成投資人焦點

投資人目前最關注的，將是Meta下一款新模型「Watermelon」的發布日期，分析師認為可能在下個月稍晚推出。
Jefferies分析師Jeffrey Favuzza周二表示，「Meta Connect」開發者大會前市場升溫的熱情，可能帶來「利多出盡」行情，尤其Meta股價周一已大漲11%，但隨著下一款模型即將發布這項催化劑存在，「我們認為股價有更持久的底部支撐」。
Meta股價周二震盪走低，終場下跌0.6%。
美銀(BofA)分析師Justin Post認為，投資人先前一直擔心Meta打造差異化AI產品的能力。但Muse暢旺的人氣，還具備能完成填寫網頁表單等複雜任務的能力，已提升市場「對Meta AI投資報酬潛力的樂觀程度」。
Post進一步表示，Muse推出後的累計美國下載量，已超越其他AI應用程式同一時間點的表現。根據Sensor Tower數據，Muse在推出後12天內下載次數達143萬次，高於OpenAI ChatGPT同期的137萬次，以及Google Gemini的71萬次。
Post也提醒，Muse的人氣可能不會立即轉化為營收成長。他表示：「Muse的變現路徑，包括廣告、訂閱與佣金收入，在2028年以前似乎不太可能產生重大貢獻。」
不過，Post對Meta即將推出的Watermelon抱持樂觀態度，認為該模型可能帶來前沿水準的能力，並有望改善Meta核心廣告業務，同時增加模型託管收入。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) has seen its newly launched AI assistant Muse top the Apple US App Store download chart, with a download speed that even surpasses ChatGPT's early performance, significantly boosting market confidence in Meta's AI strategy and attracting Wall Street investors' attention.

Unlike traditional chatbots, Muse is designed to perform multi-step tasks such as booking restaurants, making phone calls, and sending emails. Its remarkable popularity gives analysts greater confidence that Meta can leverage its deep social‑media roots to create a breakout app in the AI era.
JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that although it is still early, he believes Muse has the potential to become the most widely used consumer AI application since ChatGPT.

This is a major breakthrough for Meta, as until recently the market remained skeptical about Meta's AI strategy and massive capital‑spending plans. After Muse's launch, Anmuth upgraded Meta's stock rating to "add".
Since early September, Meta's share price has risen nearly 30%, with 21% of that gain occurring in the two weeks following Muse's launch.
Anmuth pointed out several advantages of Muse, including an easy‑to‑use interface, a generous free tier, and the backing of Meta's massive user base across its social‑media platforms.

He added that Meta has been accelerating AI product rollouts, with AI model capabilities leaping forward within just a few months. In July, Meta released Muse Spark 1.1, its first AI model with near‑frontier programming abilities.

The Meta developer conference "Meta Connect" will run for two days starting Wednesday (the 23rd). Anmuth expects Meta to further update AI progress and show how Muse integrates with partners and Meta hardware.
The next‑generation model Watermelon is the focus for investors, who are keen to know its release date, which analysts think could be launched later next month.

Jefferies analyst Jeffrey Favuzza said on Tuesday that the market enthusiasm heating up before the "Meta Connect" developer conference could lead to a "buy‑the‑rumor" rally, especially since Meta's stock jumped 11% on Monday, but with the upcoming model as a catalyst, "we believe the price now has a more durable bottom support."
Meta's stock slipped on Tuesday, closing down 0.6%.

Bank of America analyst Justin Post noted that investors had previously worried about Meta's ability to build differentiated AI products. Muse's strong popularity and its capability to handle complex tasks like filling out web forms have raised market optimism about Meta AI's investment return potential.

Post added that cumulative U.S. downloads of Muse since launch have already outperformed other AI apps at the same point in time. According to Sensor Tower, Muse was downloaded 1.43 million times within 12 days, exceeding OpenAI's ChatGPT at 1.37 million and Google Gemini at 710,000.

Post cautioned that Muse's popularity may not translate into immediate revenue growth, saying "Muse's monetization paths—including ads, subscriptions and commission revenue—are unlikely to make a material contribution before 2028."

Nevertheless, Post remains optimistic about Meta's upcoming Watermelon model, believing it could deliver frontier‑level capabilities, improve Meta's core advertising business, and increase model‑hosting revenue.

items.title: 馬斯克：20年後可能有1,000億台人形機器人
items.title_en: Musk: In 20 years there could be 100 billion humanoid robots
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克接受《央視》專訪，談及機器人，他認為未來每個人都能擁有專屬機器人，這些機器人可以照料年邁父母，看護孩童，還能擔任孩子一對一私教，承擔各類工作。
馬斯克說，未來一個人可以操控成百上千台甚至上萬台實體機器人和數位智慧體。
「我的預測是十年內至少有10億台人形機器人，未來15年或許達到100億台，未來20年可能達到1,000億台。」馬斯克說。
paras_en: Tesla CEO Elon Musk in an interview with CCTV discussed robots, saying everyone could have a personal robot that can care for elderly parents, look after children, and even serve as a one‑on‑one tutor, handling various tasks.
Musk said that in the future a person could control hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of physical robots and digital intelligences.
“My prediction is that within ten years there will be at least 1 billion humanoid robots, in fifteen years perhaps 10 billion, and in twenty years possibly 100 billion,” Musk said.

items.title: AI與機器人續主導！《財富》中國40歲以下商界菁英榜出爐：宇樹王興興再入選　張雪、姚順雨首入榜
items.title_en: AI and Robotics Continue to Lead! Forbes China’s Under‑40 Business Elite List Released: YuShu’s Wang Xingxing Returns, Zhang Xue and Yao Shunyu Make First‑Time Appearances
paras: 《財富》中文版周二(22日)發布2026年「中國40位40歲以下的商界精英」榜單，年度主題為「把技術敘事兌現為商業現實」，設置了主榜與「中國40歲以下最具潛力的商界精英」子榜，主榜共40位青年商業領袖入選，聚焦已完成商業化落地的新生代企業家群。
上述榜單已連16年發布，本屆成員年齡橫跨25歲至39歲，AI、人形機器人、新能源儲能、先進製造、生物醫藥、消費與硬科技投資成為集中賽道。
人選集中來自於AI與機器人產業。36歲的宇樹科技創辦人王興興曾在2023年、2025年兩度上榜，今年再度入選。
今年8月19日，他帶領宇樹科技登陸科創板，成為A股「人形機器人第一股」，發行價每股150.8人民幣，上市首日開盤報1100元、漲629.44%，總市值一度沖至約人民幣4449億元，此後回落至約2000億元。
33歲的月之暗面Kimi創辦人楊植麟，以「AI時代中國新創公司的典型代表」身份上榜。今年7月17日，該公司發表新一代旗艦大模型Kimi K3，總參數達2.8兆、原生多模態並支援100萬字元上下文，針對長程程式設計、知識工作與複雜推理，成為全球參數規模最大的開源大模型。
37歲的MiniMax創辦人閔俊傑，是公司商業化落地的核心推手。該公司自研模型及AI原生應用程式已累計服務來自超過230個國家和地區的逾3億名個人用戶，以及來自100多個國家和地區的200萬餘名企業客戶和開發者。今年上半年，MiniMax營收1.17億美元、年增283.1%，經調整淨虧損2.93億美元。

在首次入選者中，科技與製造業的世代更替同樣明顯。 28歲的騰訊首席AI科學家姚順雨，出生於1998年，清華畢業、普林斯頓計算機博士，2024年加入OpenAI，參與Operator、Deep Research與Computer-Using Agent等項目研發，去年12月出任騰訊總裁辦公室首席AI科學家，同時負責AI Infra部與大語言模型部門，今年7月公司進一步將多模態模型部門與大語言模型部門合併為基礎模型部由其統管。
33歲的語用科技創辦人林俊暘，曾任阿里通義千問核心架構師與技術負責人，2026年3月離職後創辦語用科技，將重點從基礎模型轉向跨數位與物理世界的Agent，已獲高榕創投與紅杉中國共同領投、騰訊及上海未來基金支持，天使輪融資約20億美元。
39歲的張雪機車創辦人張雪則作為新型機械工業代表上榜。今年3月，該公司賽車在WSBK葡萄牙站WorldSSP組別連奪兩回合冠軍，成為中國摩托車品牌首次在該頂級賽事登頂，公司最新引入紅杉中國1.5億元投資。
對比往屆，AI與機器人的高比例是延續而非突變。相較於2025年，ai、人形機器人、新能源儲能、先進製造、生物醫藥、消費、硬科技投資成為今年集中領域。
paras_en: Forbes China’s Chinese-language edition released its 2026 "China’s 40 Under‑40 Business Elite" list on Tuesday (the 22nd), with the annual theme "Turning Technological Narratives into Business Realities". The list features a main ranking and a sub‑ranking titled "China’s Most Promising Business Elite Under 40," with 40 young business leaders selected for the main list, focusing on a new generation of entrepreneurs who have already achieved commercial rollout.

The list, now in its 16th year, includes members aged 25 to 39, with AI, humanoid robotics, new‑energy storage, advanced manufacturing, biomedicine, consumer sectors and hard‑tech investing emerging as the concentrated tracks.

The selections are heavily weighted toward the AI and robotics sectors. Wang Xingxing, 36, founder of YuShu Technology, previously appeared on the list in 2023 and 2025 and is featured again this year.

On August 19, he led YuShu Technology to debut on the STAR Market, becoming the A‑share “first humanoid‑robot stock.” The IPO price was RMB 150.8 per share; on the first trading day the stock opened at RMB 1,100, jumping 629.44% and briefly pushing the market cap to about RMB 444.9 billion before settling around RMB 200 billion.

Yang Zhilin, 33, founder of Kimi, the “Moon’s Dark Side,” made the list as a typical example of a Chinese AI‑era startup. On July 17, the company unveiled its next‑generation flagship large model Kimi K3, with 2.8 trillion parameters, native multimodality and support for up to one million characters of context, targeting long‑range programming, knowledge work and complex reasoning, making it the world’s largest open‑source model by parameter count.

Min Junjie, 37, founder of MiniMax, is the key driver behind the company’s commercial rollout. Its self‑developed models and AI‑native applications have served over 300 million individual users across more than 230 countries and regions, and over 2 million enterprise customers and developers from more than 100 countries. In the first half of this year MiniMax generated $117 million in revenue, up 283.1% year‑on‑year, while its adjusted net loss stood at $293 million.

Among the first‑time entrants, a generational shift in technology and manufacturing is also evident. Yao Shunyu, 28, Tencent’s chief AI scientist, was born in 1998, graduated from Tsinghua and earned a PhD in computer science from Princeton. He joined OpenAI in 2024, contributing to projects such as Operator, Deep Research and Computer‑Using Agent. In December last year he became chief AI scientist of Tencent’s President’s Office, overseeing AI Infra and the large‑language‑model division, and in July this year the company merged its multimodal‑model and large‑language‑model units into a foundational‑model division under his leadership.

Lin Junyang, 33, founder of Yuyong Technology, previously served as core architect and tech lead for Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen. After leaving Alibaba in March 2026, he started Yuyong Technology, shifting focus from foundational models to agents that bridge digital and physical worlds. The startup secured a $2 billion angel round led jointly by Gaorong Capital and Sequoia China, with participation from Tencent and Shanghai Future Fund.

Zhang Xue, 39, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycles, represents the new‑type machinery industry on the list. In March this year the company’s race bike won both rounds of the WorldSSP class at the WSBK Portugal round, marking the first time a Chinese motorcycle brand topped that premier series. The firm recently attracted a RMB 150 million investment from Sequoia China.

Compared with previous years, the high proportion of AI and robotics selections reflects continuity rather than a sudden shift. Relative to 2025, AI, humanoid robotics, new‑energy storage, advanced manufacturing, biomedicine, consumer sectors and hard‑tech investing are the focal areas for this year.

items.title: 蘋果即將加入輝達5兆美元俱樂部？分析師這樣看
items.title_en: Apple Poised to Join Nvidia's $5 Trillion Club? Analysts Weigh In
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，隨著市場對蘋果(AAPL-US)新款iPhone與AI策略的期待升溫，蘋果正逐步逼近一項重大里程碑。
蘋果股價周二(22日)盤中創下345.34美元歷史新高，之後收在339.75美元，市值達到4.96兆美元。根據道瓊市場數據，蘋果股價在盤中一度突破5兆美元市值門檻。
今年稍早，蘋果也曾在7月28日及29日盤中交易期間觸及5兆美元市值里程碑。
截至目前，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)是唯一一家收盤市值突破5兆美元的公司。不過，一些分析師對蘋果股價持續走高抱持信心，尤其是隨著iPhone 18周期逐步展開。美銀分析師Wamsi Mohan給予蘋果370美元目標價，明顯高於使蘋果市值達到5兆美元所需的342.60美元目標價。
蘋果近期產品發表後市場熱情升溫，推動股價自本月初以來上漲7.2%。在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)帶領下，蘋果推出iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max，以及首款摺疊iPhone Duo。蘋果也透過iOS 27與Mac OS 27更新，陸續推出最新的Apple Intelligence功能。
分析師認為，摺疊手機的推出擴大了蘋果的整體潛在市場規模(TAM)，並可能隨著時間推進獲得主流市場採用。
Mohan在9月9日產品發布後的報告中寫道，「Duo在經過長時間後帶來了具意義的外型變化，並將硬體與軟體無縫整合。」
摩根大通分析師Samik Chatterjee認為，即使蘋果提高手機售價，仍能透過租賃方案、舊機換購及電信商補貼維持正向的銷量周期。他在本月的一份報告中寫道，iPhone Duo「令人印象深刻的功能展現」，也讓蘋果在高階產品上具備潛在的銷量上行空間。
除了近期的硬體產品發布外，相較於其他投入數千億美元建設資料中心基礎設施的大型科技公司，蘋果在AI領域採取了更為審慎的策略。
這項策略也為投資人帶來回報。今年以來，蘋果股價已上漲25%，相比之下，Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGS-US)上漲10%，標普500指數則上漲13.4%。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that as market anticipation heats up for Apple’s (AAPL-US) new iPhone and AI strategy, the company is gradually closing in on a major milestone.

Apple’s stock hit a record high of $345.34 intraday on Tuesday the 22nd, later closing at $339.75, giving it a market value of $4.96 trillion. According to Dow Jones market data, the stock briefly breached the $5 trillion market‑cap threshold during the session.
Earlier this year Apple also touched the $5 trillion market‑cap mark during intraday trading on July 28 and 29.

To date Nvidia (NVDA-US) remains the only company whose closing market value has surpassed $5 trillion. Nonetheless, several analysts remain confident that Apple’s stock can keep climbing, especially as the iPhone 18 cycle unfolds. Bank of America analyst Wamsi Mohan has a $370 price target for Apple, well above the $342.60 target needed to push the market cap to $5 trillion.

Following Apple’s recent product launch, market enthusiasm surged, driving the stock up 7.2% since the start of the month. Under new CEO John Ternus, Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, as well as its first foldable iPhone Duo. Apple also rolled out the latest Apple Intelligence features via iOS 27 and macOS 27 updates.
Analysts say the introduction of a foldable phone expands Apple’s total addressable market and could, over time, gain mainstream adoption.
Mohan wrote in a report after the September 9 product launch, “The Duo, after a long development period, brings a meaningful form‑factor change and seamlessly integrates hardware and software.”

JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee believes that even if Apple raises handset prices, it can still sustain a positive sales cycle through leasing programs, trade‑in offers, and carrier subsidies. In a report this month he described the iPhone Duo’s “impressive feature showcase,” giving Apple upside potential in its premium segment.
Beyond the recent hardware releases, Apple’s AI strategy is more cautious compared with other large tech firms that are spending hundreds of billions building data‑center infrastructure.
That strategy has rewarded investors. So far this year Apple’s stock is up 25%, versus a 10% rise for the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US) and a 13.4% gain for the S&P 500 index.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】料BOJ升息緩慢，日圓備受壓力
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank Anticipates Slow BOJ Rate Hikes, Yen Under Pressure
paras: ◆USD/JPY

芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比與聖路易斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆均主張美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步升息，並據美國總統川普表示願意會見將出席紐約舉行的聯合國大會的伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚，重燃兩國重啟談判的希望，導致油價下跌，提振市場情緒，而且日本央行(BOJ)上周調升利率，但兩名委員反對加息及缺乏明確鷹派指引，市場押注BOJ難以跟上全球主要央行的鷹派步伐，讓日本與主要經濟體之間維持較大利率差距，令日圓承壓，週二適逢日本假期休市，交投清淡，推動美元兌日圓觸及157.77高點。

據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯發文稱，因未來通貨膨脹持續高於2%目標的風險上升，支持FED上周加息，里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金亦稱，美國經濟越來越強勁，通貨膨脹風險仍占上風，但上周傳言日本曾對美元兌日圓詢價，此舉被視為當局入市干預的前兆，限制日圓走貶，並據美國總統川普表示，伊朗一直與美國進行接觸，認為兩國最終將達成協議，而且油價下跌，緩解通貨膨脹擔憂，打壓美元兌日圓至156.80低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼表示，經濟復甦和通貨膨脹前景面臨風險，但澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特重申，今年可能不得不第四次加息以控制通貨膨脹，並據RBA總裁布洛克稱，鑒於能源價格居高不下且國內需求持續過度，通貨膨脹面臨的上行風險可能正在顯現，市場分別加大押注RBA與RBNZ再加息，提振澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，德國主要經濟研究機構包括WI研究所、伊福經濟研究所、IfW智庫、IWH以及DIW分別將今、明兩年經濟增長預期上調至1.3%及1.1%，帶動歐元兌美元盤整於1.1478高點。

隨後歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩表示，推高油氣價格的能源衝擊持續時間恐比ECB在3月預期的要長，地緣政治風險似乎再次升高，並據ECB指出，中國工業轉型正在將歐洲企業擠出全球市場，機械設備與運輸設備行業受影響尤為顯著，其中德國企業遭遇的衝擊最大，而且歐元區9月消費者信心指數較前月降1.0點至負16.5，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1428低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1450-70，支撐於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國數據顯示8月公共部門借款達183億英鎊高於預期，並上修2026/27財政年前四個月借款數據，累計赤字再超出官方預測，增添財政大臣希首份預算案前壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3387高點下滑。據英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布9月工業訂單差值升至負9，但伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽，推動油價下跌，減輕英國央行(BOE)升息壓力，導致英鎊兌美元跌至1.3318低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3340-60，支撐於1.3250-70。

Chicago Fed President Goolsbee and St. Louis Fed President Mussailem both advocated further rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (FED). They noted that President Trump is willing to meet Iran’s President Raisi at the UN General Assembly in New York, reviving hopes for renewed negotiations between the two countries, which pushed oil prices lower and boosted market sentiment. The Bank of Japan (BOJ) raised rates last week, but two members opposed the hike and there was no clear hawkish guidance, leading the market to bet that the BOJ will struggle to keep pace with major central banks, widening interest‑rate differentials and pressuring the yen. Tuesday was a Japanese holiday with thin trading, driving USD/JPY up to a high of 157.77.

Boston Fed President Collins wrote that the risk of inflation staying above the 2% target is rising, supporting the Fed’s rate hike last week. Richmond Fed President Barkin also said the U.S. economy is getting stronger and inflation risks remain dominant. Last week rumors surfaced that Japan had queried USD/JPY rates, seen as a pre‑emptive intervention to curb yen weakness. President Trump said Iran is in contact with the U.S. and expects a deal, and falling oil prices eased inflation concerns, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.80. The pair is expected to find support around 156.90‑157.10 and resistance near 157.80‑158.00.
EUR/USD

Markets are increasing bets on further hikes by both the RBA and RBNZ, lifting the Australian and New Zealand dollars. items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元徘徊近8周高點 Fed官員強調通膨風險
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Hovers Near 8-Week High as Fed Officials Emphasize Inflation Risks
paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Tuesday (the 22nd), continuing the boost from the Fed’s rate hike last week. The euro fell after weak consumer‑confidence data were released.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 100.54, its highest level since July 29.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously last Wednesday to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%. In addition, the Fed’s updated economic outlook summary showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sent a clear hawkish signal at the post‑decision press conference.
Higher‑rate environments generally favor a stronger dollar. Since the Fed’s hike, the dollar has gained nearly 1%.

Boston Fed President Susan Collins reiterated her support for the FOMC’s decision on Tuesday. In a social‑media post she stressed that elevated price pressures call for a more restrictive policy stance to achieve long‑term price stability.
She added that recent economic indicators suggest that after more than five years of persistently high costs, the likelihood of a scenario where “inflation is clearly above 2%” has increased.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin also backed the FOMC’s rate‑rise decision, noting that current inflation risks are higher than the risks posed by full employment.
Oil prices become a market focus

A major theme this month is central‑bank tightening driven by energy‑related price pressures, with both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening policy. Against this backdrop, recent declines in oil prices have drawn attention from FX market participants.

Benchmark crude has fallen for five consecutive trading days, driven by easing concerns over supply disruptions and hopes for progress in Middle‑East diplomacy. Traders were encouraged by Saudi Arabia’s decisive actions to offset the impact of a key pipeline closure that was damaged during the expanded conflict with Iran‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces.

U.S. President Donald Trump’s possible meeting with the Iranian delegation, including its foreign minister and president, during the United Nations General Assembly this week has also lifted market sentiment. In a speech at the UN on Tuesday, Trump said he believes an agreement between Washington and Tehran will be reached after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “What’s happening this week could be pivotal for the medium‑term direction of crude prices, because the key players in the U.S.–Iran conflict will start talks in New York today. The agreements and consensus reached in those talks could determine whether the war escalates or a path out of the conflict is found.”

He noted, “The trajectory of oil prices will continue to affect global inflation and the policy choices of central banks. We have seen every major central bank (including the Fed) cite energy prices or ‘geopolitics’ as a driver for future decisions. That is the underlying reason for the recent hawkish rhetoric.”

Wizman added, “We still link higher oil prices with a stronger dollar against major currencies. This is not because high oil prices would force the Fed to hike rates; if oil rises further, all central banks would turn hawkish. The reason is that U.S. economic growth and the dollar benefit from improved trade terms and real‑income effects from higher oil prices. We believe the U.S.–Iran conflict, by keeping crude prices elevated, has become a key factor supporting the dollar’s strength this year.”
Euro weakens, yen slips slightly
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1448. Earlier data showed Euro‑area consumer confidence for September weakened from August, ending a four‑month streak of improvement.

On the other hand, after the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week, the yen briefly accelerated its depreciation but has now paused, with little change in the exchange rate. The dollar/yen is slightly above the flat level at 157.38.

Because Japan is entering a continuous holiday period, Asian trading volumes are low. FX allocation firms warn that this seasonal lull can amplify market volatility and the impact of central‑bank actions.

The Nikkei reported that the BOJ has conducted a formal “exchange‑rate inquiry” with the FX trading desk, heightening market anxiety. The procedure involves central‑bank officials calling commercial banks to request real‑time executable rate quotes.

Although the yen has continued to weaken after the BOJ’s non‑consensus 25‑basis‑point hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31‑year high, market strategists point out that Tokyo still wields massive policy firepower. Japan holds roughly $1 trillion in foreign‑exchange reserves, providing ample liquidity to authorities.
